title: Hold approvals to provide a QEC service
what: Provide regulated education and care to 7 or more children at once, in a service outside the National Law, only as an approved provider of a QEC approved service.

sources.title: Education and Care Services Act 2013 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not provide regulated education and care to 7 or more children at the same time unless— (a) the person is an approved provider for the service at which the regulated education and care is provided; and (b) the service is a QEC approved service

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Education and Care Services Act 2013 (Qld)

sources.title: Education and Care Services Act 2013 (Qld)
sources.locator: s 14, words naming the body (found 20 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: The chief executive must not grant the provider approval unless the chief executive is satisfied— (a) the applicant is a suitable person to operate a QEC service;

reach.condition: if it provides education and care to 7 or more children at once in a service the National Law does not cover
